title: Testing & Verification
desc: How to verify a change end to end.
lede: Before a change is done, it's verified — backend, lint, and frontend.
body:
At a glance
  • pytest across tests/ and plugins.
  • ruff for linting.
  • Frontend vitest / build.
  • Tests expected with changes.

What to run

  • pytest — backend and plugin-local tests.
  • ruff — Python linting.
  • vitest / build — frontend tests and build.

Expectation

Changes ship with tests and a clean verification run. Plugin tests live with their plugin — see Testing Your Plugin.
